West Bengal CM Adhikari Addresses Baruipur Unrest and Investment

West Bengal Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari visited Baruipur following unrest and the killing of an auto-rickshaw driver, Indrajit Mondal. Adhikari provided financial assistance of ₹25 lakh to Mondal's family and assured them of government support. He stated he would not label the killing as 'lynching' and instead pointed fingers at 'moulobadis' (extremists). Adhikari also laid the foundation stone for a ₹600-crore Lux Cozi garment hub, promising to create a business-friendly environment by improving law and order and ending extortion.
